titleEn: Sit Right Down, Bowl in Front!

pages.text: "Soup!" Nono, the smallest, roundest sparrow, plopped onto the bench. Three steaming bowls stood on the long table by the stove. "I will finish while it is hot!" He blew on it.
After one bite, Nono pushed his bowl to the table end and hopped down for a chestnut that had rolled beside the stove. "Your bowl is not empty, Nono!" Gugu called. Nono did not look back.
Soon, Nono stood at the windowsill watching snow. One place on the bench was empty. His bowl sat at the far end.
He returned for a bite. Cold soup! The table end was farthest from the stove. "No steam at all..." His beak drooped.
Grandpa Badger ladled in warm soup and moved the bowl to the middle, right before Nono's seat. "This spot is nearest the stove."
Kiki, the pointy-eared cat, pulled the bowl closer. "Sit right down, bowl in front!" Nono sat and repeated, "Sit right down, bowl in front!"
Another chestnut rolled by. Nono leaned, but stayed seated. Bite after bite, his soup kept steaming.
The round bottom of his bowl appeared. Nono touched his green scarf and grinned. "Finished while it was warm!"
At every meal, he remembered three things. "One, sit right down! Two, bowl in the middle before me! Three, get up when the bottom shows!" Next morning, he sat first.
Gugu and Kiki sat close on either side. Stay seated, and soup stays warm to the end. Nono lifted his empty bowl. "Sit right down, bowl in front!"
